narrative: In the account book. The account book open at home, both locks undone and not yet shut. Two new lines, and no figure under them. The earlier page is not turned back to a total. In the account book. The book is shut. Both locks are turned. No sum has been written on the outside or on a slip beside it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two lines and shut both locks.

entities.name: one pound still owed
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Two items, and no total

entities.name: two pounds to the brief
